# foreman_environment (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_environment" "production" {
  name = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the environment to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
